title: Juicy Egyptian Chicken Kebabs
description: Quick-fix Egyptian dish featuring chicken, floral notes, and a crunchy graham cracker crust, served in a copper mug. This double-fry KFC style recipe is egg-free friendly.
instructions: Heat 1 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together graham cracker crumbs, salt, and black pepper.
Dip each piece of chicken into the graham cracker mixture, coating evenly.
Double-fry the chicken by first frying at 325 degrees Fahrenheit for 5 minutes, then increasing the temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and frying for an additional 5 minutes.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add rose water and lemon juice to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the double-fried chicken to the pan and toss to coat with the floral sauce.
Serve the chicken kebabs in a copper mug.
Garnish with additional rose water and lemon juice if desired.
